  • Method Details

    • showStartMenu

      public void showStartMenu()
      Displays the start menu of the game. The menu includes a "Start the game" button and an image. Clicking the button initiates the game loop and draws the game board.

    • draw

      public void draw()
      Draws the game screen on the stage. The method creates a new Pane and adds various game elements to it, such as the game board, player, enemies, projectiles, items, and inventory/HP display. It also checks if all enemies are dead and triggers the end screen if applicable. Finally, it sets the created Pane as the scene on the stage for display.

    • drawBoard

      public void drawBoard()
      Draws the game board by creating ImageView objects for each block in the model's board, setting the appropriate image based on the block's value, and positioning them within a Pane. The method retrieves the list of blocks from the model's board and iterates over them, creating an ImageView for each block, setting its image using the graphicsMap, and positioning it based on the block's coordinates and the block size. The ImageView objects are added to the board Pane for display.

    • drawPlayer

      public void drawPlayer(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Draws the player on the specified pane. The player is represented by an image and is positioned based on their coordinates. The player's image is rotated based on the player's facing direction.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane on which to draw the player.

    • drawEnemies

      public void drawEnemies(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Draws the enemies on the specified pane. Each enemy is represented by an image and positioned based on their coordinates.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane on which to draw the enemies.

    • drawProjectiles

      public void drawProjectiles(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Draws the projectiles on the specified pane. It iterates through the player's projectiles and the enemies' projectiles, calling the drawProjectile() method to draw each projectile.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane on which to draw the projectiles.

    • drawInventoryHP

    • upgrade

      public void upgrade()
      Displays the upgrade options for the player. Allows the player to upgrade various attributes such as damage, attack speed, max HP, and movement speed. The upgrade options are presented as buttons on the specified pane.

    • end

      public void end(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Displays the end of the level message on the pane. Informs the player to press ESC to end the level.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane where the end message will be displayed.

    • goodEnd

      public void goodEnd()
      Displays the "good end" screen on the pane. The screen shows a green overlay with the text "LEVEL COMPLETED" and an "Exit the game" button.

    • badEnd

      public void badEnd()
      Displays the "bad end" screen on the pane. The screen shows a red overlay with the text "GAME OVER" and an "Exit the game" button.
